name: Country / Domain Intelligence Slice
problem: An analyst or agent needs country-level comparative data with sources, freshness, evidence states and reconciliation warnings rather than an opaque ranking.
use_when: compare these countries on this metric
which countries lead on this domain and why
show me the evidence behind this country score
inputs: One or more countries plus a domain/question; optional metric slugs, comparison set and as-of date.
outputs: Sourced observations, evidence state/confidence, source URLs, reconciliation findings, methodology context, signals and limitations.
pricing: Raven contains a country-brief pricing hypothesis ($299-$2,500 depending depth). No approved fixed machine price/payment path was verified, so it is not auto-quotable.
confirmation: Read-only sourced data may be returned within approved access. No paid obligation without explicit confirmation and verified terms.
payment_authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path for this capability.
invocation_status: LIVE: public machine discovery docs plus central Evercraft MCP matching. Commercial execution remains verification-gated; no automatic checkout or payment obligation.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
